# 2-Week Statistics Exam Prep Plan

A focused 14-day plan for your **2026-11-18** exam, built around **90 minutes on weekdays** and **3 hours on weekends**. It gives extra time to **hypothesis testing** and **regression**, plus **one full practice exam** and **two review sessions**.

## Day-by-Day Study Schedule

| Day | Date | Time | Focus | Key Tasks | Checkpoint |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2026-11-04 | 90 min | Probability foundations | Sample spaces; events; conditional probability | 10-min quiz: basic probability rules |
| 2 | 2026-11-05 | 90 min | Probability practice | Bayes’ rule; independence; mixed problems | Solve 6–8 problems without notes |
| 3 | 2026-11-06 | 90 min | Confidence intervals | CI logic; interpretation; margin of error | Write 3 correct interpretations |
| 4 | 2026-11-07 | 3 hrs | Hypothesis testing I | Null/alternative; p-values; Type I/II errors; one-sample tests | Mini-set: 8 questions, aim 80%+ |
| 5 | 2026-11-08 | 3 hrs | Regression I | Scatterplots; correlation; least squares; slope/intercept meaning | Explain a regression output in words |
| 6 | 2026-11-09 | 3 hrs | Regression II + review checkpoint | Residuals; assumptions; prediction; common mistakes | 30-min checkpoint review of Days 1–5 |
| 7 | 2026-11-10 | 90 min | ANOVA basics | One-way ANOVA idea; F-statistic; when to use it | 5-question concept check |
| 8 | 2026-11-11 | 90 min | Hypothesis testing II | Two-sample tests; paired tests; choosing the right test | Build a test-selection decision tree |
| 9 | 2026-11-12 | 90 min | Confidence intervals + mixed review | Compare CI types; revisit weak points | 15-minute mixed quiz |
| 10 | 2026-11-13 | 3 hrs | Full practice exam | Timed exam under realistic conditions | Mark weak topics by section |
| 11 | 2026-11-14 | 90 min | Review session 1 | Deep review of practice exam errors; fix formulas and logic | Error log updated with 5–10 items |
| 12 | 2026-11-15 | 3 hrs | Hypothesis testing III + regression drills | Hard problems; interpretation; test choice; regression inference | Redo missed practice-exam questions |
| 13 | 2026-11-16 | 90 min | Review session 2 | Focused review of weakest 2 topics; summary sheet | 1-page final formula/steps sheet |
| 14 | 2026-11-17 | 90 min | Light final review | Flash review; key definitions; easy mixed problems | Stop early if accuracy stays high |

## Weekly Focus and Review Checkpoints

### Week 1: Build core understanding
- Probability and confidence intervals early to warm up the basics.
- Put extra energy into **hypothesis testing** and **regression** on the weekend.
- **Checkpoint on Day 6:** identify your top 3 recurring mistakes.

### Week 2: Test readiness and correction
- Use the practice exam to expose weaknesses under time pressure.
- Spend both review sessions on error correction, not rereading.
- **Checkpoint on Day 11:** confirm which topic still costs the most points.
- **Checkpoint on Day 13:** finalize a short formula and interpretation sheet.

### Priority allocation
- **Hypothesis testing:** 4 sessions
- **Regression:** 4 sessions
- **Probability:** 2 sessions
- **Confidence intervals:** 2 sessions
- **ANOVA:** 1 focused session + mixed review
- **Practice exam:** 1 full timed run
- **Review sessions:** 2 dedicated sessions
